request_mail.subject: Pickup: :contents for :recipient
request_mail.body:
Hello,

please pick up at our yard: :contents, :size.

Deliver to: :recipient, :district
Needed by: :due

Otherwise the technician stands in front of a hole in the wall and looks at it. He is good at that, but it does not fix anything.

Please confirm the route with a short mail.

Regards,
:contact
:sender

vehicle.met: And the right vehicle. Accounting nods.
vehicle.missed: You sent the truck for one parcel. The parcel had plenty of room. Accounting has less patience.

punctuality.met: At :recipient in time. The technician could get to work.
punctuality.missed: Late at :recipient. The technician stood at the customer without the part. We will hear about this.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :contents for :recipient
feedback_mail.outro:
Every shipment arrives somewhere. Ideally on time.

Tammy

reminder_mail.subject: :contents for :recipient?
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

the shipment for :recipient is still not on any route. Plan the route, confirm to the sender. The usual.

Tammy

complaint_mail.subject: Complaint: :contents
complaint_mail.body:
Hello,

our technician stood at a customer today without the :contents. The part was due with us by :due. It was not with us.

We now have a second appointment and a customer who no longer waves at our van.

Annoyed regards,
:recipient
